summary_en: Presents Sonar-MASt3R, a real-time opti-acoustic reconstruction method that combines dense optical correspondences from MASt3R with geometric information from acoustic 3D reconstruction. The method is designed for underwater intervention in highly turbid, unstructured scenes and is experimentally evaluated over a wide turbidity range.

summary_en: Develops a self-supervised dual-branch blind-spot network for sonar despeckling from single noisy images. Separate branches target smooth and texture-rich regions, with adaptive fusion and loss weighting intended to suppress speckle while preserving structural detail across synthetic, side-scan, and forward-looking sonar data.
